name: Speed or frequency matching device
summary: Adjusts or supervises the difference between two speed or frequency references.
description: Adjusts or supervises the difference between two speed or frequency references.

In a drafting package, connect this reference to the two references being compared. The associated drawing should trace the governor or matching command; the number identifies the role and does not specify the terminal arrangement, ratings or operating settings.
readingNotes: Identify the two references being compared.
Trace the governor or matching command.
drawingChecklist: Label the two references being compared.
Cross-reference the governor or matching command.
Identify the device tag, manual revision and logic drawing that define this implementation.
distinction: Matching speed or frequency is one aspect of synchronisation and does not replace the complete synchronism check.
